custom_fields.label: Inquiry ID (negotiationId)
custom_fields.description: Saga thread id; joins T2/T5 audit. Populated for all prompts.

custom_fields.label: Buyer LEI
custom_fields.description: GLEIF LEI of the buying entity. Populated for all prompts.

custom_fields.label: Buyer Agent
custom_fields.description: Buyer agent handle (e.g. tommyBuyerAgent). Populated for all prompts.

custom_fields.label: Buyer OOR
custom_fields.description: Buyer Official Org Role holder (e.g. Tommy_Chief_Procurement_Officer). P05, P08, P10.

custom_fields.label: Required Delivery Date
custom_fields.description: Header-level required date (also mirrored to expected_closing). All prompts.

custom_fields.label: Delivery Destination
custom_fields.description: Header-level destination distinct from billing address (e.g. Rotterdam, NL). All prompts.

custom_fields.label: Incoterm Requested
custom_fields.description: Requested Incoterm if specified by buyer.

custom_fields.label: Payment Term Requested
custom_fields.description: Requested single payment term (Net-0 / Net-30 / Net-60). P01-P10.

custom_fields.label: Compare Terms Requested (JSON)
custom_fields.description: JSON array for compare-mode, e.g. ["Net-0","Net-30"]. P02.

custom_fields.label: Target Basket (JSON)
custom_fields.description: Per-style target rates JSON. P07, P08, P09, P10.

custom_fields.label: Demand Aware
custom_fields.description: 1 if buyer asked us to consider our order book. P09, P10.

custom_fields.label: Due Diligence Required
custom_fields.description: 1 if buyer asked seller to run DD on itself. P05, P08, P10.

custom_fields.label: Inquiry Dimensions (JSON snapshot)
custom_fields.description: Verbatim parsed inquiry JSON snapshot (audit-safe). All prompts.
